# Nymphas’ House Church (Colossians 4:15)

## Emotional Focus
Making room in the home for God’s family.

## Key KJV
“Salute the brethren which are in Laodicea, and Nymphas, and the church which is in his house.” (Colossians 4:15)

## Gentle Retelling
Nymphas opened his house so friends could meet, pray, and learn about Jesus together. His home became a little church.

## Coloring Prompt
People gathered happily in a simple home for church.

## Read-Along Flow + Response
“Our home can be a safe place for God’s family.”
